summary: Chippewa County, WI tower placed at Pine Lake (1941) or in the town of Sampson (1996), listed as removed with no date; 1941 and 1996 newspaper and sheriff items name it.

facts.status_note: The Forest Lookouts page says Removed and the FFLA county list says Tower Gone; no removal date in the sources read.

Norman Deminsky is reported employed at the 'Stang' fire tower at Pine Lake.
Break-in reported at the Stang tower on 305th Avenue, the third that year; nothing taken, contents thrown outside.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1941 item places the 'Stang' tower at Pine Lake; the September 1996 sheriff call entry places it in the town of Sampson. The story reports both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Historic detail comes from one page (Forest Lookouts, Stang) that quotes Chippewa Herald-Telegram items; the newspapers themselves were not read. The 1938 watchman item names Sampson, not Stang, so the story does not attribute it to this tower. Place names conflict (1941 says Pine Lake, 1996 says the town of Sampson); both are kept. No build date, design, removal date or site description was found. Two web searches returned nothing specific to this tower; the WXPR 2015 article is statewide context and does not name Stang, so the story does not link the removal to that decision. The brief's record matches the sources (Chippewa County, WI DNR, gone); no corrections. Coordinates from the FFLA list (45.28490, -91.47189) and OSM node 353894103 (45.2849621, -91.4715496, elevation 372 m) agree within about 30 m; not checked against a map. Web searches: 2. Page reads: about 5.
